channel.title: Relay Updates
channel.description: Signed updates for Relay on macOS.

item.description:
# Relay 0.3.26
- Move the search window by dragging the search icon or empty space along its header. - Relay remembers where you leave it, including after quitting and reopening the app. - Search and clipboard windows share the saved position. Changing result heights keeps the search field in place. - If a display is disconnected or resized, Relay brings the window back into the visible screen area.

# Relay 0.3.25
- The recording toolbar stays visible while choosing a window or application. - Clear guidance explains macOS's Share This Window step and when to click Record. - Cancel or Escape restores usable controls; completing a selection shows its window/application name. - Recording controls remain available on the current desktop after selection.

# Relay 0.3.24
- Compact screen recording controls beside the existing screenshot tools. Screenshot remains the default, with Draw selected for markup. - Record a screen, window, application, or selected area, including exact pixel coordinates. - Optional click indicators, system audio, microphone, and compression choices. - Pause and resume without keeping the paused time; Stop saves an MP4 to Desktop.
Screen recording requires macOS 15 or later. Existing screenshot and markup features remain available on macOS 14.
